name: Enthalpy v0.4.18
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.18

## Changed

- Area and Project scopes now include matching daily-note sections. General
  content and sections for other Areas or Projects stay excluded from reads
  and searches. Full workspace still includes complete daily notes.
- Automation read-scope choices are Area, Project, and Full workspace.

## Fixed

- New Automation runs no longer show false interruption warnings after their
  steps succeed. Existing run history can still contain the old warnings.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
